plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: your own film across the top, muted with a pause; your packages and prices; what couples receive and when, with the dates from their wedding day; and a Meet us page with every question.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: Check your date from your availability sheet (free, held or booked, never a booking), with the sunset that day; your films, each with its own page and a venue finder; your photographs; a packages page with Build your own and your deposit link; and every question on one page.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: your film in chapters with full screen; the day planner, a filming timeline from their ceremony time with portraits in that evening's golden hour; the light planner; your film's progress for each couple by code; venues with their light and drone rules; music and licensing explained; your team; and something made just for your studio.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Meet us. Plus adds Check your date, the films and their pages, the photographs, the packages page with Build your own, and the questions page.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: the film in chapters, the day planner, the light planner and each couple's film progress, plus venues, music, the team and your own pages.
